verdict.rationale: Token2's management tools could plausibly offer scheduled or background automation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no user-configurable automations that run on their own. The only background item is a fixed headless watcher that opens the GUI when a key is inserted, and the Entra ID bulk-enrollment script is a one-off scripted action, not a recurring autonomous automation. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
